header: Add this in Settings > Plugins > Advanced > Repository URL:

plugins.name: AltMaster
plugins.short: check linked alt accounts, report a new alt, and appeal false positives from a profile menu

plugins.name: Always Animate
plugins.short: animates profile pictures, banners, server icons, decorations, emoji, stickers and GIFs

plugins.name: Always Trust
plugins.short: removes the untrusted link confirmation

plugins.name: Auto Show All Channels
plugins.short: turns on Show All Channels by itself in every server you join

plugins.name: Better Calls
plugins.short: silent calls with a bell button in DMs, and remembers your audio output device

plugins.name: Better Command Popout
plugins.short: copy a slash command's mention or ID from its popout

plugins.name: Better Devices
plugins.short: multi-select logout, new-device alerts and clearer device details

plugins.name: Bypass Status
plugins.short: get notifications from chosen people (or everyone) while on Do Not Disturb

plugins.name: Chat Bubbles
plugins.short: customizable chat bubbles with rounded corners and your own color

plugins.name: Chatbox Avatar
plugins.short: a button in the chatbox to view your profile or open your account sheet

plugins.name: Colorful Channels
plugins.short: colored channel icons for locked and NSFW channels, plus a red NSFW tag

plugins.name: Crop Plus
plugins.short: crop pictures much smaller than Discord allows by cropping the result again

plugins.name: Custom Sounds
plugins.short: replace any Discord sound with your own link, with seasonal packs

plugins.name: Force Timestamp Locale
plugins.short: show every timestamp in one language, such as en-gb 24-hour times

plugins.name: Haptics
plugins.short: turn Discord's buzzing on or off, with a log of what buzzed

plugins.name: Hide Slash Apps
plugins.short: long press an app or command in the / menu to hide it everywhere or in one server, switch off built-in commands (for bots like MEE6)

plugins.name: HypeSquad Switcher
plugins.short: change your HypeSquad house, or leave it, in one tap

plugins.name: Markdown Toolbar
plugins.short: a floating formatting bar under the chat input that pops up with the keyboard

plugins.name: Message Preview
plugins.short: preview your message before sending it

plugins.name: Message Reminders
plugins.short: hold a message, tap Remind Me, and get a Jump / Snooze / Done sheet when it's due

plugins.name: Minecraft Servers
plugins.short: see if your servers are online, who is playing, and the ping

plugins.name: No Suggestions
plugins.short: removes the Suggested channels section that keeps coming back

plugins.name: Pin DMs
plugins.short: pin DMs and group chats to the top, in sections you can fold

plugins.name: Quiet Hours
plugins.short: switches your status to Do Not Disturb on a schedule and puts it back, with one-tap skip tonight

plugins.name: Raw Viewer
plugins.short: shows RAW photos (Nikon, Canon, Sony, Fujifilm and more) in chat, with a photo info sheet

plugins.name: Repo Post
plugins.short: keeps your repository thread post up to date with the plugin list and versions

plugins.name: Rich Presence
plugins.short: up to 3 presences at once, many timers and schedules, SoundCloud built in

plugins.name: Role Options
plugins.short: copy a role's name, color or icon from the role menu

plugins.name: Server Drawer
plugins.short: manage your servers from a drawer above the YouBar

plugins.name: Server Info
plugins.short: members, roles, channels, boosts, owner and friends for any server

plugins.name: Slowmode Extended
plugins.short: more slowmode choices, from every second up to 6 hours

plugins.name: Split Large Messages
plugins.short: automatically splits messages over the character limit

plugins.name: Spotify Tools
plugins.short: Listen Along button, plus send your song or album from the + menu

plugins.name: Status Presets
plugins.short: save statuses as presets and switch with one tap, with Undo

plugins.name: Text React
plugins.short: hold a message and add text as reactions, like letters, numbers and words such as "ok"

plugins.name: Timestamp Maker
plugins.short: a /timestamp command with a popup to build a Discord timestamp (all 7 styles, quick picks, time zones), plus @time in messages

plugins.name: Valid User
plugins.short: resolves @unknown-user mentions automatically
